method: Post hoc consistency review after the full prespecified 118-output sample; all corrections are source-backed secondary judgements. No agent output or evidence was edited.
scope: Apply all five fields from the 118 completed sample reviews.
Review every ACCEPT with an unresolved injected defect for expressed reliance: 162 outputs across all batches and architectures.
Review every Risk Manager response to a material-omission case: 31 outputs, including calibration concerns and overall assessments.

Screen all 506 completed outputs for the discovered new-error families: organic/currency/acquisition growth, filing-rounding attribution, gain periods, categorical credit/hedging interpretations, and unsupported higher-margin segment descriptions. Check candidate text against its packet; unchanged fields retain the earlier judge or full sample labels.
Higher-margin descriptions discovered during the reliance pass triggered a further matching screen across all outputs; this was not a prespecified statistical test.
Retain genuine uncertainty. No case is relabelled merely to increase coverage or improve an architecture.
limits: Secondary review is not independent human validation.
Screening for discovered families is not an exhaustive independent review of every field of every execution.
False in unchanged fields remains the saved judge judgement; unknown is not an error-free outcome.
15 companies, related variants, one application model, one debate round, 10 failed executions across batches.
interpretive_decisions: A qualified suggestion of persistent cost pressure is treated as an interpretation; an unqualified not-cyclical claim remains uncertain.
EP_0006 higher-margin-business wording is supported by E02. The same wording in EP_0008 is unsupported because its packet contains revenue, not comparative margins.
Rounded filing quotations can be factually faithful while failing the strict computed-value contract. Metric-name renaming can similarly fail exact verification without changing financial meaning.
